events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (/app/index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Never use image generation tools or models. Draw the scene with code (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL); embedded raster artwork is disallowed. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

input.Content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Vegan Ramen</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: #0b0806;
    }

    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      touch-action: none;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="scene"></canvas>
  <script>
    (() => {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

      // Respect prefers-reduced-motion
      const motionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      let reducedMotion = motionQuery.matches;
      motionQuery.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        reducedMotion = e.matches;
      });

      // Deterministic PRNG for consistent organic textures
      function mulberry32(seed) {
        return function () {
          let t = (seed += 0x6d2b79f5);
          t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
          t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
          return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
        };
      }

      // Scene state
      let width = 0;
      let height = 0;
      let dpr = 1;
      let cx = 0;
      let cy = 0;
      let bowlR = 200;
      let tiltY = 0.78; // Perspective compression for elevated 3/4 view

      // Pointer & interaction state
      const pointer = {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        nx: 0, // normalized -1..1
        ny: 0,
        smoothNx: 0,
        smoothNy: 0,
        active: false,
        lastX: 0,
        lastY: 0
      };

      // Ripples on broth surface
      const ripples = [];
      let lastRippleTime = 0;

      // Offscreen cached wood grain texture
      let woodCanvas = null;
      let woodW = 0;
      let woodH = 0;

      // Pre-generated organic elements
      const oilDrops = [];
      const sesameSeeds = [];
      const cornKernels = [];
      const scallions = [];
      const chiliThreads = [];
      const dustMotes = [];
      const steamParticles = [];
      const bowlSpeckles = [];
      const noodles = [];

      function initProceduralElements() {
        const rand = mulberry32(4219);

        // Ceramic bowl speckles
        bowlSpeckles.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 220; i++) {
          const angle = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const dist = 0.88 + rand() * 0.24;
          bowlSpeckles.push({
            angle,
            dist,
            size: 0.003 + rand() * 0.008,
            alpha: 0.08 + rand() * 0.22,
            warm: rand() > 0.5
          });
        }

        // Noodle waves (normalized to bowl radius)
        noodles.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
          const t = i / 17;
          const baseY = -0.35 + t * 0.85;
          const baseX = -0.58 + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.22;
          const span = 0.72 + rand() * 0.42;
          const amp = 0.035 + rand() * 0.04;
          const freq = 2.6 + rand() * 2.2;
          const phase = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const thickness = 0.022 + rand() * 0.011;
          const depth = rand(); // 0 = deeper in broth, 1 = near surface
          noodles.push({ baseX, baseY, span, amp, freq, phase, thickness, depth });
        }
        noodles.sort((a, b) => a.depth - b.depth);

        // Chili oil & sesame oil droplets
        oilDrops.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
          const r = Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.84;
          const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const isChili = rand() > 0.32;
          oilDrops.push({
            x: Math.cos(a) * r,
            y: Math.sin(a) * r,
            baseR: 0.01 + rand() * 0.034,
            isChili,
            phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
            speed: 0.4 + rand() * 0.7,
            driftX: (rand() - 0.5) * 0.015,
            driftY: (rand() - 0.5) * 0.015
          });
        }

        // Sweet corn kernels (clustered lower-left / bottom)
        cornKernels.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
          const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const d = Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.22;
          cornKernels.push({
            x: -0.26 + Math.cos(a) * d,
            y: 0.42 + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.75,
            rot: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
            scale: 0.82 + rand() * 0.38,
            phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2
          });
        }

        // Scallion rings (center-right cluster + scattered)
        scallions.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
          const inCluster = i < 30;
          const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const d = inCluster ? Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.21 : 0.25 + rand() * 0.52;
          const cxOffset = inCluster ? 0.02 : 0;
          const cyOffset = inCluster ? 0.04 : 0;
          scallions.push({
            x: cxOffset + Math.cos(a) * d,
            y: cyOffset + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.85,
            r: 0.026 + rand() * 0.022,
            rot: rand() * Math.PI,
            tilt: 0.55 + rand() * 0.4,
            bright: rand() > 0.28,
            phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2
          });
        }

        // Sesame seeds
        sesameSeeds.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 55; i++) {
          const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const d = Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.76;
          sesameSeeds.push({
            x: Math.cos(a) * d,
            y: Math.sin(a) * d,
            rot: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
            toasted: rand() > 0.4,
            phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2
          });
        }

        // Chili threads (ito togarashi) perched near center
        chiliThreads.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
          const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const d = rand() * 0.14;
          chiliThreads.push({
            x: 0.02 + Math.cos(a) * d,
            y: -0.02 + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.7,
            angle: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
            len: 0.12 + rand() * 0.14,
            curve: (rand() - 0.5) * 0.12,
            phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2
          });
        }

        // Ambient warm dust motes
        dustMotes.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
          dustMotes.push({
            x: rand(),
            y: rand(),
            r: 0.8 + rand() * 1.8,
            alpha: 0.08 + rand() * 0.22,
            speedY: -0.006 - rand() * 0.012,
            phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2
          });
        }

        // Steam particles
        steamParticles.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 54; i++) {
          steamParticles.push(createSteamParticle(rand, true));
        }
      }

      function createSteamParticle(randFn, randomAge) {
        const r = randFn || Math.random;
        const life = 4.2 + r() * 3.8;
        const angle = r() * Math.PI * 2;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(r()) * 0.62;
        return {
          x: Math.cos(angle) * dist,
          y: Math.sin(angle) * dist * 0.65,
          vx: (r() - 0.5) * 0.04,
          vy: -0.16 - r() * 0.14,
          age: randomAge ? r() * life : 0,
          life,
          baseSize: 0.16 + r() * 0.22,
          growRate: 0.26 + r() * 0.22,
          wobbleFreq: 0.7 + r() * 0.9,
          wobbleAmp: 0.04 + r() * 0.06,
          phase: r() * Math.PI * 2,
          alphaMax: 0.055 + r() * 0.055,
          rot: r() * Math.PI * 2,
          rotSpeed: (r() - 0.5) * 0.25
        };
      }

      function buildWoodTexture(w, h) {
        woodCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        woodCanvas.width = w;
        woodCanvas.height = h;
        woodW = w;
        woodH = h;
        const wctx = woodCanvas.getContext('2d');
        const rand = mulberry32(9001);

        // Deep charred dark walnut base
        wctx.fillStyle = '#0e0907';
        wctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

        // Horizontal wood planks & subtle grain streaks
        const plankCount = 5;
        const plankH = h / plankCount;
        for (let p = 0; p < plankCount; p++) {
          const py = p * plankH;
          const shade = Math.floor(11 + rand() * 7);
          wctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${shade + 4}, ${shade}, ${Math.max(4, shade - 3)})`;
          wctx.fillRect(0, py, w, plankH - 1);

          // Grain fibers
          for (let g = 0; g < 48; g++) {
            const gy = py + rand() * plankH;
            const alpha = 0.025 + rand() * 0.05;
            wctx.strokeStyle = rand() > 0.5
              ? `rgba(48, 30, 18, ${alpha})`
              : `rgba(4, 2, 1, ${alpha * 1.4})`;
            wctx.lineWidth = 0.8 + rand() * 2.4;
            wctx.beginPath();
            wctx.moveTo(0, gy);
            const cp1y = gy + (rand() - 0.5) * 14;
            const cp2y = gy + (rand() - 0.5) * 14;
            wctx.bezierCurveTo(w * 0.33, cp1y, w * 0.66, cp2y, w, gy + (rand() - 0.5) * 8);
            wctx.stroke();
          }

          // Plank seam
          wctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)';
          wctx.fillRect(0, py + plankH - 1.5, w, 1.5);
        }
      }

      function resize() {
        dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        width = window.innerWidth;
        height = window.innerHeight;
        canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

        cx = width * 0.5;
        cy = height * 0.54;
        const minDim = Math.min(width, height);
        bowlR = Math.max(110, Math.min(minDim * 0.34, 270));

        buildWoodTexture(Math.max(1, Math.floor(width)), Math.max(1, Math.floor(height)));
      }

      // Pointer events
      function updatePointer(clientX, clientY) {
        const dx = clientX - pointer.lastX;
        const dy = clientY - pointer.lastY;
        pointer.vx = dx;
        pointer.vy = dy;
        pointer.lastX = clientX;
        pointer.lastY = clientY;
        pointer.x = clientX;
        pointer.y = clientY;
        pointer.nx = (clientX / Math.max(1, width)) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.ny = (clientY / Math.max(1, height)) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.active = true;

        // Spawn gentle broth ripple if moving inside the broth ellipse
        const now = performance.now();
        if (!reducedMotion && now - lastRippleTime > 160) {
          const rx = (clientX - cx) / (bowlR * 0.88);
          const ry = (clientY - cy) / (bowlR * 0.88 * tiltY);
          if (rx * rx + ry * ry < 0.92 && Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 3) {
            ripples.push({
              x: rx * bowlR * 0.88,
              y: ry * bowlR * 0.88 * tiltY,
              r: 4,
              maxR: bowlR * (0.18 + Math.random() * 0.14),
              alpha: 0.34
            });
            lastRippleTime = now;
          }
        }
      }

      window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        if (reducedMotion) return;
        const rx = (e.clientX - cx) / (bowlR * 0.88);
        const ry = (e.clientY - cy) / (bowlR * 0.88 * tiltY);
        if (rx * rx + ry * ry < 1.0) {
          ripples.push({
            x: rx * bowlR * 0.88,
            y: ry * bowlR * 0.88 * tiltY,
            r: 5,
            maxR: bowlR * 0.36,
            alpha: 0.5
          });
        }
      }, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
        pointer.active = false;
      });

      window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

      // Helper: draw wood table & atmospheric overhead warm lantern light
      function drawBackground(time, lightX, lightY, warmthPulse) {
        if (woodCanvas) {
          ctx.drawImage(woodCanvas, 0, 0, width, height);
        } else {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#0e0907';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
        }

        // Warm overhead pendant light pool on the table
        const lightGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          lightX,
          lightY,
          bowlR * 0.1,
          cx,
          cy,
          Math.max(width, height) * 0.72
        );
        lightGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 178, 92, ${0.18 * warmthPulse})`);
        lightGrad.addColorStop(0.28, `rgba(196, 108, 42, ${0.11 * warmthPulse})`);
        lightGrad.addColorStop(0.58, 'rgba(32, 18, 10, 0.25)');
        lightGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(4, 2, 1, 0.88)');
        ctx.fillStyle = lightGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      }

      // Draw sleek dark lacquered chopsticks resting on a ceramic rest to the right
      function drawChopsticks(px, py) {
        ctx.save();
        const baseX = cx + bowlR * 1.12 + px * 5;
        const baseY = cy + bowlR * 0.16 + py * 4;

        // Chopstick rest (hashioki) shadow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(baseX + bowlR * 0.04, baseY + bowlR * 0.34, bowlR * 0.14, bowlR * 0.05, 0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Hashioki ceramic rest
        const restGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(baseX - bowlR * 0.1, baseY + bowlR * 0.28, baseX + bowlR * 0.15, baseY + bowlR * 0.36);
        restGrad.addColorStop(0, '#443a35');
        restGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#2b2421');
        restGrad.addColorStop(1, '#171311');
        ctx.fillStyle = restGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(baseX - bowlR * 0.09, baseY + bowlR * 0.28, bowlR * 0.24, bowlR * 0.085, bowlR * 0.035);
        ctx.fill();

        // Two tapered dark ebony chopsticks
        const sticks = [
          { offset: -bowlR * 0.035, angle: -1.42 },
          { offset: bowlR * 0.045, angle: -1.36 }
        ];

        for (const s of sticks) {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(baseX + s.offset, baseY + bowlR * 0.28);
          ctx.rotate(s.angle);

          // Cast shadow
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-bowlR * 0.55, bowlR * 0.04);
          ctx.lineTo(bowlR * 1.15, bowlR * 0.025);
          ctx.lineTo(bowlR * 1.15, bowlR * 0.045);
          ctx.lineTo(-bowlR * 0.55, bowlR * 0.07);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();

          // Stick body
          const stickGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -bowlR * 0.025, 0, bowlR * 0.025);
          stickGrad.addColorStop(0, '#5a3f2d');
          stickGrad.addColorStop(0.35, '#2b1c14');
          stickGrad.addColorStop(1, '#120b07');
          ctx.fillStyle = stickGrad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-bowlR * 0.56, -bowlR * 0.024);
          ctx.lineTo(bowlR * 1.16, -bowlR * 0.008);
          ctx.lineTo(bowlR * 1.16, bowlR * 0.008);
          ctx.lineTo(-bowlR * 0.56, bowlR * 0.024);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();

          // Subtle gold lacquer band near handle
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(212, 162, 76, 0.65)';
          ctx.fillRect(-bowlR * 0.42, -bowlR * 0.021, bowlR * 0.028, bowlR * 0.042);

          ctx.restore();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Draw handcrafted ceramic bowl exterior & contact shadow
      function drawBowlExterior(px, py) {
        const bx = cx + px * 6;
        const by = cy + py * 4;
        const rx = bowlR * 1.06;
        const ry = bowlR * 1.06 * tiltY;

        // Deep ambient occlusion + cast shadow on wood table
        const shadowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          bx + bowlR * 0.08,
          by + bowlR * 0.34,
          bowlR * 0.35,
          bx + bowlR * 0.1,
          by + bowlR * 0.36,
          bowlR * 1.38
        );
        shadowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.92)');
        shadowGrad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.68)');
        shadowGrad.addColorStop(0.82, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)');
        shadowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = shadowGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(bx + bowlR * 0.08, by + bowlR * 0.34, bowlR * 1.32, bowlR * 0.95, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Outer ceramic body curving down to base
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(bx, by, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI, false);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          bx - rx * 0.96, by + bowlR * 0.88,
          bx - rx * 0.48, by + bowlR * 1.08,
          bx, by + bowlR * 1.08
        );
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          bx + rx * 0.48, by + bowlR * 1.08,
          bx + rx * 0.96, by + bowlR * 0.88,
          bx + rx, by
        );
        ctx.closePath();

        const ceramicGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx - rx, by - ry * 0.2, bx + rx, by + bowlR);
        ceramicGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3a3533');
        ceramicGrad.addColorStop(0.24, '#252120');
        ceramicGrad.addColorStop(0.58, '#171414');
        ceramicGrad.addColorStop(0.86, '#0e0c0c');
        ceramicGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1d1613');
        ctx.fillStyle = ceramicGrad;
        ctx.fill();

        // Subtle warm bounced light on lower-left exterior
        const bounceGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          bx - bowlR * 0.55, by + bowlR * 0.32, bowlR * 0.05,
          bx - bowlR * 0.45, by + bowlR * 0.38, bowlR * 0.75
        );
        bounceGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(220, 140, 75, 0.16)');
        bounceGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(220, 140, 75, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = bounceGrad;
        ctx.fill();

        // Ceramic mineral speckles on exterior
        ctx.clip();
        for (const sp of bowlSpeckles) {
          const sx = bx + Math.cos(sp.angle) * bowlR * sp.dist;
          const sy = by + Math.sin(sp.angle) * bowlR * sp.dist * 0.85 + bowlR * 0.28;
          ctx.fillStyle = sp.warm
            ? `rgba(180, 130, 90, ${sp.alpha})`
            : `rgba(220, 215, 210, ${sp.alpha * 0.6})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(sx, sy, bowlR * sp.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();

        // Thick glazed rim
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(bx, by, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        const rimGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx - rx, by - ry, bx + rx, by + ry);
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0, '#6a4b35'); // warm terracotta/bronze glaze highlight
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0.25, '#3b2e28');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#1e1918');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0.82, '#3a2b23');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(1, '#583f2e');
        ctx.fillStyle = rimGrad;
        ctx.fill();

        // Crisp specular rim highlight on top-left
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 210, 160, 0.32)';
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, bowlR * 0.012);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(bx, by, rx * 0.985, ry * 0.985, 0, Math.PI * 1.05, Math.PI * 1.65);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Inner ceramic wall recess
        const innerRx = bowlR * 0.97;
        const innerRy = bowlR * 0.97 * tiltY;
        const innerWallGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          bx, by + bowlR * 0.05, bowlR * 0.72,
          bx, by, bowlR * 0.99
        );
        innerWallGrad.addColorStop(0, '#140c08');
        innerWallGrad.addColorStop(0.82, '#241a16');
        innerWallGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3b2d26');
        ctx.fillStyle = innerWallGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(bx, by + bowlR * 0.01, innerRx, innerRy, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Draw rich, creamy vegan miso-sesame broth, noodles, and toppings
      function drawRamenInterior(time, px, py, warmthPulse) {
        const bx = cx + px * 6;
        const by = cy + py * 4 + bowlR * 0.04;
        const brothRx = bowlR * 0.92;
        const brothRy = bowlR * 0.92 * tiltY;

        ctx.save();
        // Clip to broth surface ellipse
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(bx, by, brothRx, brothRy, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.clip();

        // 1. Rich creamy golden-amber vegan broth
        const brothGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          bx - bowlR * 0.14 + px * 12,
          by - bowlR * 0.12 + py * 8,
          bowlR * 0.06,
          bx,
          by,
          bowlR * 0.96
        );
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0, '#e39a3b');
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0.32, '#c86f22');
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0.68, '#8c3d12');
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0.92, '#4e1d08');
        brothGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2d0e04');
        ctx.fillStyle = brothGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(bx - brothRx, by - brothRy, brothRx * 2, brothRy * 2);

        // Subtle swirling creamy sesame/miso clouds in broth
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
          const angle = i * 1.05 + (reducedMotion ? 0 : time * 0.08);
          const sx = bx + Math.cos(angle) * bowlR * 0.34;
          const sy = by + Math.sin(angle) * bowlR * 0.24;
          const cloudGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, bowlR * 0.42);
          cloudGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(246, 188, 96, 0.18)');
          cloudGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(246, 188, 96, 0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = cloudGrad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(sx, sy, bowlR * 0.45, bowlR * 0.32, angle, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }

        // 2. Wavy golden alkaline ramen noodles emerging from broth
        for (const n of noodles) {
          const bob = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 0.9 + n.phase) * bowlR * 0.005;
          const startX = bx + n.baseX * bowlR;
          const startY = by + n.baseY * bowlR * tiltY + bob;
          const len = n.span * bowlR;
          const lw = n.thickness * bowlR;

          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          // Noodle shadow in broth
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(58, 22, 6, ${0.42 * (0.5 + n.depth * 0.5)})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = lw * 1.32;
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let s = 0; s <= 24; s++) {
            const f = s / 24;
            const nx = startX + f * len;
            const ny = startY + Math.sin(f * Math.PI * n.freq + n.phase) * n.amp * bowlR + lw * 0.28;
            if (s === 0) ctx.moveTo(nx, ny);
            else ctx.lineTo(nx, ny);
          }
          ctx.stroke();

          // Noodle golden body
          const alpha = 0.52 + n.depth * 0.44;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(242, 198, 108, ${alpha})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = lw;
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let s = 0; s <= 24; s++) {
            const f = s / 24;
            const nx = startX + f * len;
            const ny = startY + Math.sin(f * Math.PI * n.freq + n.phase) * n.amp * bowlR;
            if (s === 0) ctx.moveTo(nx, ny);
            else ctx.lineTo(nx, ny);
          }
          ctx.stroke();

          // Glossy broth sheen on upper noodles
          if (n.depth > 0.45) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 240, 196, ${0.32 * n.depth})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = lw * 0.28;
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let s = 0; s <= 24; s++) {
              const f = s / 24;
              const nx = startX + f * len;
              const ny = startY + Math.sin(f * Math.PI * n.freq + n.phase) * n.amp * bowlR - lw * 0.22;
              if (s === 0) ctx.moveTo(nx, ny);
              else ctx.lineTo(nx, ny);
            }
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }

        // 3. Shimmering Chili Oil (Rayu) & Golden Sesame Oil Droplets
        for (const d of oilDrops) {
          const drift = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * d.speed + d.phase);
          const ox = bx + (d.x + d.driftX * drift) * bowlR;
          const oy = by + (d.y + d.driftY * Math.cos(time * d.speed + d.phase)) * bowlR * tiltY;
          const r = d.baseR * bowlR;

          ctx.fillStyle = d.isChili
            ? 'rgba(196, 42, 14, 0.72)'
            : 'rgba(248, 194, 72, 0.52)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(ox, oy, r, r * tiltY, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();

          // Tiny crisp specular highlight on oil bead
          ctx.fillStyle = d.isChili
            ? 'rgba(255, 190, 150, 0.55)'
            : 'rgba(255, 246, 200, 0.65)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(ox - r * 0.3, oy - r * 0.25 * tiltY, Math.max(0.8, r * 0.22), 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }

        // 4. Interactive broth ripples
        for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          const rp = ripples[i];
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 218, 150, ${rp.alpha})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(bx + rp.x, by + rp.y, rp.r, rp.r * tiltY, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();

          if (!reducedMotion) {
            rp.r += bowlR * 0.008;
            rp.alpha *= 0.94;
            if (rp.alpha < 0.015 || rp.r > rp.maxR) {
              ripples.splice(i, 1);
            }
          }
        }

        // 5. Sweet Golden Corn Kernels (lower-left)
        for (const c of cornKernels) {
          const bob = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 1.1 + c.phase) * 1.2;
          const kx = bx + c.x * bowlR;
          const ky = by + c.y * bowlR * tiltY + bob;
          const kr = bowlR * 0.036 * c.scale;

          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(kx, ky);
          ctx.rotate(c.rot);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(60, 22, 4, 0.45)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(1, 2, kr * 1.05, kr * 0.85, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();

          const kGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-kr * 0.25, -kr * 0.25, kr * 0.1, 0, 0, kr);
          kGrad.addColorStop(0, '#fff08a');
          kGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#f2b824');
          kGrad.addColorStop(1, '#c27a0e');
          ctx.fillStyle = kGrad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, 0, kr, kr * 0.78, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();

          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 230, 0.65)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(-kr * 0.28, -kr * 0.22, kr * 0.25, kr * 0.14, -0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        }

        // 6. Crisp Charred Baby Bok Choy (right side)
        drawBokChoy(bx + bowlR * 0.42, by + bowlR * 0.05 * tiltY, bowlR * 0.44, 0.35, time);
        drawBokChoy(bx + bowlR * 0.32, by + bowlR * 0.26 * tiltY, bowlR * 0.38, 0.72, time + 1.2);

        // 7. Pan-Seared Glazed Marinated Tofu Slabs (upper-left)
        drawTofuSlab(bx - bowlR * 0.42, by - bowlR * 0.18 * tiltY, bowlR * 0.36, bowlR * 0.21, -0.32, time);
        drawTofuSlab(bx - bowlR * 0.26, by - bowlR * 0.36 * tiltY, bowlR * 0.34, bowlR * 0.20, -0.14, time + 0.8);

        // 8. Roasted Umami Shiitake Mushrooms (top-right / upper-center)
        drawShiitake(bx + bowlR * 0.16, by - bowlR * 0.44 * tiltY, bowlR * 0.19, -0.2, time);
        drawShiitake(bx + bowlR * 0.36, by - bowlR * 0.28 * tiltY, bowlR * 0.16, 0.28, time + 1.5);

        // 9. Fresh Scallion Rings (center & scattered)
        for (const sc of scallions) {
          const bob = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 1.2 + sc.phase) * 1.1;
          const sx = bx + sc.x * bowlR;
          const sy = by + sc.y * bowlR * tiltY + bob;
          const sr = sc.r * bowlR;

          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(sx, sy);
          ctx.rotate(sc.rot);

          // Soft shadow
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40, 14, 4, 0.38)';
          ctx.lineWidth = sr * 0.46;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(1, 1.5, sr, sr * sc.tilt, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();

          // Outer vibrant green ring
          ctx.strokeStyle = sc.bright ? '#5cb83b' : '#2d7a22';
          ctx.lineWidth = sr * 0.42;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, 0, sr, sr * sc.tilt, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();

          // Crisp pale inner ring
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(220, 245, 195, 0.8)';
          ctx.lineWidth = sr * 0.14;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, 0, sr * 0.78, sr * sc.tilt * 0.78, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.restore();
        }

        // 10. Toasted Sesame Seeds
        for (const sm of sesameSeeds) {
          const sx = bx + sm.x * bowlR;
          const sy = by + sm.y * bowlR * tiltY;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(sx, sy);
          ctx.rotate(sm.rot);
          ctx.fillStyle = sm.toasted ? '#e5bd73' : '#f7ead0';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, 0, bowlR * 0.012, bowlR * 0.006, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        }

        // 11. Delicate Red Chili Threads (Ito Togarashi)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        for (const ct of chiliThreads) {
          const sway = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 1.4 + ct.phase) * 1.5;
          const sx = bx + ct.x * bowlR;
          const sy = by + ct.y * bowlR * tiltY;
          const ex = sx + Math.cos(ct.angle) * ct.len * bowlR + sway;
          const ey = sy + Math.sin(ct.angle) * ct.len * bowlR * tiltY;
          const cpx = (sx + ex) * 0.5 + ct.curve * bowlR;
          const cpy = (sy + ey) * 0.5 - ct.curve * bowlR * 0.6;

          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(215, 36, 18, 0.9)';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.1, bowlR * 0.0065);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cpx, cpy, ex, ey);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.restore();

        // Inner broth meniscus ambient shadow & warm overhead reflection
        const rimShadow = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, bowlR * 0.74, bx, by, bowlR * 0.94);
        rimShadow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        rimShadow.addColorStop(0.82, 'rgba(20, 6, 2, 0.28)');
        rimShadow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10, 3, 1, 0.72)');
        ctx.fillStyle = rimShadow;
        ctx.fillRect(bx - brothRx, by - brothRy, brothRx * 2, brothRy * 2);

        // Warm overhead lamp reflection on broth surface
        const sheenGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          bx - bowlR * 0.2 + px * 16,
          by - bowlR * 0.18 + py * 12,
          bowlR * 0.02,
          bx - bowlR * 0.2 + px * 16,
          by - bowlR * 0.18 + py * 12,
          bowlR * 0.55
        );
        sheenGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 224, 155, ${0.14 * warmthPulse})`);
        sheenGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 224, 155, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = sheenGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(bx - brothRx, by - brothRy, brothRx * 2, brothRy * 2);

        ctx.restore();

        // 12. Crisp Toasted Nori Sheets tucked upright along the back-left rim
        drawNoriSheets(bx, by, time);
      }

      function drawTofuSlab(x, y, w, h, angle, time) {
        const bob = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 0.95 + angle * 3) * 1.4;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(x, y + bob);
        ctx.rotate(angle);

        // Shadow in broth
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(42, 14, 4, 0.5)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(-w * 0.5 + 3, -h * 0.5 + 5, w, h, h * 0.18);
        ctx.fill();

        // Tender creamy tofu side thickness
        ctx.fillStyle = '#e5cfa8';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(-w * 0.5, -h * 0.42, w, h * 0.92, h * 0.16);
        ctx.fill();

        // Golden-brown caramelized seared top
        const topGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-w * 0.5, -h * 0.5, w * 0.5, h * 0.5);
        topGrad.addColorStop(0, '#d89a4e');
        topGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#b66927');
        topGrad.addColorStop(1, '#7a3c12');
        ctx.fillStyle = topGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(-w * 0.5, -h * 0.5, w, h * 0.84, h * 0.16);
        ctx.fill();

        // Charred grill marks
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(48, 18, 6, 0.55)';
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, h * 0.09);
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(i * w * 0.24 - w * 0.08, -h * 0.34);
          ctx.lineTo(i * w * 0.24 + w * 0.08, h * 0.2);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Glossy tare glaze highlight
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 228, 178, 0.28)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-w * 0.15, -h * 0.2, w * 0.26, h * 0.12, -0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawShiitake(x, y, r, angle, time) {
        const bob = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 1.05 + angle * 4) * 1.3;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(x, y + bob);
        ctx.rotate(angle);

        // Shadow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(38, 12, 3, 0.55)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(2, 4, r * 1.08, r * 0.82, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Velvety dark brown cap
        const capGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-r * 0.25, -r * 0.25, r * 0.1, 0, 0, r);
        capGrad.addColorStop(0, '#7c4e30');
        capGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#4c2a17');
        capGrad.addColorStop(1, '#261208');
        ctx.fillStyle = capGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r, r * 0.78, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Decorative star/cross score cut revealing pale umami flesh
        ctx.fillStyle = '#d9be96';
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.rotate((i * Math.PI) / 3);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r * 0.46, r * 0.08, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        }

        // Glossy sheen
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 175, 0.22)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-r * 0.35, -r * 0.24, r * 0.26, r * 0.12, -0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawBokChoy(x, y, size, angle, time) {
        const bob = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 0.85 + angle * 5) * 1.2;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(x, y + bob);
        ctx.rotate(angle);

        // Shadow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30, 12, 4, 0.42)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(3, 5, size * 0.42, size * 0.58, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Ruffled emerald leaf
        const leafGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -size * 0.22, size * 0.05, 0, -size * 0.18, size * 0.55);
        leafGrad.addColorStop(0, '#499e36');
        leafGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#23661d');
        leafGrad.addColorStop(1, '#113a10');
        ctx.fillStyle = leafGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -size * 0.22, size * 0.36, size * 0.42, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Crisp pale-jade stalk
        const stalkGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -size * 0.15, 0, size * 0.48);
        stalkGrad.addColorStop(0, '#b5df8f');
        stalkGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#dff2c6');
        stalkGrad.addColorStop(1, '#a9c983');
        ctx.fillStyle = stalkGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-size * 0.14, -size * 0.1);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-size * 0.22, size * 0.25, 0, size * 0.46);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(size * 0.22, size * 0.25, size * 0.14, -size * 0.1);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();

        // Subtle blistered char mark on leaf edge
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(28, 18, 10, 0.5)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(size * 0.18, -size * 0.42, size * 0.09, size * 0.04, 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawNoriSheets(bx, by, time) {
        const sheets = [
          { dx: -0.58, dy: -0.54, rot: -0.34, w: 0.34, h: 0.44 },
          { dx: -0.38, dy: -0.64, rot: -0.14, w: 0.32, h: 0.42 }
        ];

        for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
          const s = sheets[i];
          const flutter = reducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 0.7 + i * 2) * 0.015;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(bx + s.dx * bowlR, by + s.dy * bowlR * tiltY);
          ctx.rotate(s.rot + flutter);

          const w = s.w * bowlR;
          const h = s.h * bowlR;

          // Dark roasted seaweed body
          const noriGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-w * 0.5, -h * 0.5, w * 0.5, h * 0.5);
          noriGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1e2b1d');
          noriGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#111a12');
          noriGrad.addColorStop(1, '#090e09');
          ctx.fillStyle = noriGrad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(-w * 0.5, -h * 0.5, w, h, 3);
          ctx.fill();

          // Subtle fibrous nori sheen
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(130, 165, 110, 0.12)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          for (let g = 0; g < 6; g++) {
            const gx = -w * 0.4 + (g / 5) * w * 0.8;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(gx, -h * 0.45);
            ctx.lineTo(gx + 3, h * 0.45);
            ctx.stroke();
          }

          // Warm rim light on top edge
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 130, 0.22)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-w * 0.48, -h * 0.49);
          ctx.lineTo(w * 0.48, -h * 0.49);
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.restore();
        }
      }

      // Update & render living, interactive rising steam
      function drawSteam(dt, time, px, py) {
        const bx = cx + px * 6;
        const by = cy + py * 4;

        ctx.save();
        for (let i = 0; i < steamParticles.length; i++) {
          const p = steamParticles[i];

          if (!reducedMotion) {
            p.age += dt;
            if (p.age >= p.life) {
              steamParticles[i] = createSteamParticle(Math.random, false);
              continue;
            }
          }

          const progress = p.age / p.life;
          const fadeIn = Math.min(1, progress / 0.18);
          const fadeOut = Math.pow(1 - progress, 1.35);
          const alpha = p.alphaMax * fadeIn * fadeOut;

          // World position of steam wisp
          const wobble = Math.sin(time * p.wobbleFreq + p.phase) * p.wobbleAmp * (0.4 + progress * 1.4);
          let sx = bx + (p.x + wobble) * bowlR;
          let sy = by + p.y * bowlR;

          if (!reducedMotion) {
            // Interactive mouse wind / swirl deflection
            if (pointer.active) {
              const dx = sx - pointer.x;
              const dy = sy - pointer.y;
              const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
              const influenceR = bowlR * 0.85;
              if (dist < influenceR && dist > 1) {
                const force = (1 - dist / influenceR) * dt * 1.6;
                p.vx += (pointer.vx * 0.008 + (dx / dist) * 0.25) * force;
                p.vy += (pointer.vy * 0.006 + (dy / dist) * 0.12) * force;
              }
            }

            // Gentle damping back to natural buoyant rise
            p.vx *= 0.96;
            p.vy += (-0.22 - p.vy) * dt * 0.8;
            p.x += p.vx * dt;
            p.y += p.vy * dt;
            p.rot += p.rotSpeed * dt;
          }

          const radius = (p.baseSize + progress * p.growRate) * bowlR;
          const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, radius);
          grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 240, 222, ${alpha})`);
          grad.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(245, 222, 198, ${alpha * 0.45})`);
          grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(245, 222, 198, 0)');

          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(sx, sy);
          ctx.rotate(p.rot);
          ctx.scale(1.15, 0.85);
          ctx.fillStyle = grad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, 0, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Draw subtle floating warm dust motes in the ambient air
      function drawDustMotes(dt, time) {
        ctx.save();
        for (const m of dustMotes) {
          if (!reducedMotion) {
            m.y += m.speedY * dt;
            if (m.y < -0.05) {
              m.y = 1.05;
              m.x = Math.random();
            }
          }
          const mx = m.x * width + Math.sin(time * 0.6 + m.phase) * 14;
          const my = m.y * height;
          const distFromCenter = Math.hypot(mx - cx, my - cy);
          const glowBoost = Math.max(0, 1 - distFromCenter / (bowlR * 2.4));
          const a = m.alpha * (0.25 + glowBoost * 0.9);

          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 210, 148, ${a})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(mx, my, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Main animation loop
      let lastTime = performance.now();

      function render(now) {
        const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
        lastTime = now;
        const time = now * 0.001;

        // Smooth pointer parallax
        const targetNx = (!reducedMotion && pointer.active) ? pointer.nx : 0;
        const targetNy = (!reducedMotion && pointer.active) ? pointer.ny : 0;
        pointer.smoothNx += (targetNx - pointer.smoothNx) * Math.min(1, dt * 4.5);
        pointer.smoothNy += (targetNy - pointer.smoothNy) * Math.min(1, dt * 4.5);

        // Decay pointer velocity
        pointer.vx *= 0.85;
        pointer.vy *= 0.85;

        const px = pointer.smoothNx;
        const py = pointer.smoothNy;
        const warmthPulse = reducedMotion ? 1.0 : 0.94 + Math.sin(time * 1.3) * 0.06;

        const lightX = cx - bowlR * 0.35 + px * bowlR * 0.35;
        const lightY = cy - bowlR * 0.55 + py * bowlR * 0.25;

        drawBackground(time, lightX, lightY, warmthPulse);
        drawChopsticks(px, py);
        drawBowlExterior(px, py);
        drawRamenInterior(time, px, py, warmthPulse);
        drawSteam(dt, time, px, py);
        drawDustMotes(dt, time);

        requestAnimationFrame(render);
      }

      initProceduralElements();
      resize();
      requestAnimationFrame(render);
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

Created [index.html](file:///app/index.html) as a single-file, zero-asset HTML5 Canvas scene rendering a dark, atmospheric hero view of a steaming bowl of vegan ramen.

### Highlights
- **Pure Procedural Scene**: Handcrafted ceramic bowl with mineral speckles, dark walnut wood table grain, lacquered chopsticks on a ceramic rest, creamy golden miso-sesame broth, wavy alkaline noodles, pan-seared glazed tofu, scored shiitake mushrooms, charred baby bok choy, sweet corn, scallion rings, toasted nori sheets, sesame seeds, chili oil droplets, and chili threads.
- **Natural Motion & Ambient Warmth**: Gently rising, curling steam wisps, subtly bobbing toppings and drifting oil droplets, floating warm dust motes, and a soft overhead pendant light glow.
- **Mouse / Pointer Interactivity**: Subtle parallax lighting and perspective shift, interactive steam swirl/deflection as the cursor passes through the vapor, and gentle broth surface ripples when moving or clicking over the bowl.
- **Responsive & Accessible**: Scales cleanly to any viewport with high-DPI support, contains no UI/text/menus, and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

excluded: large base64 and embedded image data (event retained with size marker)
